::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

:::{#sol-expand-a-sum}

1.  Replace $i$ by each of $1, 2, 3, 4$ in turn, and add the results:

    $$
    \ba
    \sumto{i}{4} i^2
    &= 1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2 + 4^2
    \\ &= 1 + 4 + 9 + 16
    \\ &= 30
    \ea
    $$

2.  Replace $i$ by each of $1, 2, 3$ in turn inside the parentheses,
    add the three squares,
    and multiply the total by $\frac{1}{3}$:

    $$
    \frac{1}{3} \sumto{i}{3} \left(y_i - \hy_i\right)^2
    = \frac{1}{3} \left[
      \left(y_1 - \hy_1\right)^2
      + \left(y_2 - \hy_2\right)^2
      + \left(y_3 - \hy_3\right)^2
    \right]
    $$

:::

:::

::: {.content-visible when-format="revealjs"}

:::{#sol-expand-a-sum}
